decisions.reason: As a close-to-core handle family that survived the initial post-launch filtering, it likely has proven enough demand and low enough ongoing cost to stay, although the firm's broad portfolio still creates some pruning pressure.

As a single design close to many existing offerings, its option value is now largely resolved and a large broad-range firm has a stronger incentive to rationalize such overlapping variants and reallocate resources.

This electronic access system is a strategic flagship aligned with the firm's move toward integrated digital building solutions, so management is likely to preserve it unless performance clearly disappoints.
